idea-plugin.name: KMP Flavors
idea-plugin.description:
IDE support for the uk.dominikdias.kmp-flavors Gradle plugin, which brings Android-style flavor dimensions, product flavors and build types to Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Status bar widget and Tools | Select KMP Variant… to switch the variant the IDE syncs (stored as kmp.variant in local.properties), followed by a Gradle sync.
  • Flavor folders the active variant does not use are greyed out in the Project view.
  • Files in those folders get a banner explaining why they are not analysed, with a one-click switch.

action.description: Choose the kmp-flavors variant the IDE syncs
